name: unlinked
description: Model Context Protocol server for unlinked.ai — search your network, look up profiles, draft intros, and list LinkedIn imports via the unlinked.ai agent API.

setup.build_command: cd unlinked.ai/mcp-server && npm install && npm run build
setup.note: Replace /absolute/path/to/unlinked.ai with the absolute path of your clone. The server is not published to npm.

authentication.scoping: Resolved server-side to the authenticated user. Accessible data is strictly limited to the caller's own profile and direct connections.

tools.name: unlinked_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated caller's own unlinked.ai profile, plus connection and upload counts.

tools.name: unlinked_search_contacts
tools.description: Semantic search restricted to the caller's own direct connections. Returns matching profiles with a similarity score and a one-sentence reason each was included.

query.description: What kind of contact you're looking for

tools.name: unlinked_get_profile
tools.description: Look up a profile by id. Only readable if it's your own profile or a direct connection of yours; anything else returns not-found.

tools.name: unlinked_list_imports
tools.description: Return the caller's LinkedIn archive uploads plus counts of what has been ingested into their graph.

tools.name: unlinked_draft_intro
tools.description: Draft a short, forwardable intro message between the caller and one of their direct connections. Read-only -- nothing is written to unlinked.ai.

contactProfileId.description: Profile id (uuid) of the direct connection to introduce yourself to

context.description: Optional context on what you want out of the intro

private_archive_availability.note: Private archive import, scoped hosted setup and AI search remain unavailable in the deployed product. The private Noos adapter and hosted read tool are unmounted staging-only source; their synthetic receipt does not verify this legacy backend.
